items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: Reginald Forsyte wrote the song -- Dark Shadows.

ctx.x: In England -- now, that was -- Reginald Forsyte wrote the song -- Dark Shadows. And this was a big picture, and my sequence was the last sequence in th e -- in the picture, but it was a big choir behind me, and we had on those big gowns like the choir singers, you know, sing and all.
